title: Chapter 1426
text:
"What are you doing!"

The Fortitude Tree King, who was wrestling with Herberlon, immediately noticed the abnormality of the Subduing Tree King and was shocked.

'What the hell? Are you serious when you stopped?!'

Originally, the many World Tree experts had retreated at the same time and formed a battle line to support each other. They could efficiently resist the pursuit of the enemy. However, the moment the Subduing Tree King stopped, he instantly fell to the back and left the team, exposing himself to the pursuit of the enemy Beyond Grade As.

"I …"

The Subduing Tree King's body trembled as if he had just woken up from a dream. He suppressed the urge to turn around and looked at Dylan deeply before hurriedly catching up with the rest.

However, before he could speed up, Dylan raised his brows.

"What are you looking at? Why, do you want to turn around and hit me? Do you have the guts? "

The Subduing Tree King paused, gritted his teeth, ignored him, and continued to speed up.

Seeing this, Dylan sneered and said in a judgmental tone, "That's right. Continue running. A Pugilist who doesn't even have the guts doesn't even have the right to look at me."

The Subduing Tree King stopped subconsciously once again, his heart filled with shock and anger … Usually, he would not be affected by this kind of verbal conflict, but for some reason, when these words came out of this person's mouth, he could not control his emotions.

Anger rushed to his brain, and the Subduing Tree King suppressed it. Just as he was about to start again, Dylan's strange voice sounded again.

"You really stopped? You can't take it anymore? Heh, you don't even have this bit of patience. As expected of a Pugilist. Other than 'stupid', there's no other adjective suitable for you. "

As if an invisible hand had grabbed his body, the Subduing Tree King froze. He wanted to continue retreating, but he could not move his legs. A demonic murmur echoed in his heart.

"Beat him to death … Beat him to death … Beat him to death …"

The Subduing Tree King's expression changed drastically. His expression was distorted as if he was fighting with the heavens.

Suddenly, the Fortitude Tree King's roar sounded in his heart.

"Are you f * cking retreating or not?!"

The Fortitude Tree King could not take it anymore. He did not know what possessed the Subduing Tree King, but he was running intermittently. It was as if he had kidney deficiency, and he was getting more and more out of the team.

"That guy is strange. His words can provoke my anger …" The Subduing Tree King's tone was gloomy.

"Can't you block his mental message?!"

Fortitude Tree King roared angrily.

He even needed him to remind him of such a simple thing. As expected of a martial artist!

The Subduing Tree King was stunned for a moment before understanding.

Yes, I can still block him. Why didn't I react earlier?! He must have been affected by his anger and lost his mind!

The Subduing Tree King tried to convince himself, but he was unwilling to admit that although he wanted to hit someone, Dylan's words seemed to have a magical power that made him want to listen to them more …

He quickly solidified his mental barrier and blocked the external mental fluctuations. At this moment, the Subduing Tree King felt that the world had become peaceful.

Suppressing the inexplicable reluctance in his heart, he hurriedly continued running.

"Go back and support the Subduing Tree King!"

The Fortitude Tree King took over the command and ordered the World Tree experts to turn back and provide reinforcements.

The battlefield changed rapidly. Although the Subduing Tree King was only delayed for a short while, he was already a long distance away from the retreating army. He was completely alone.

Originally, many World Tree experts had already run far away and could shake off the Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations with minimal casualties. However, because the Subduing Tree King was held back by the taunts, they had no choice but to turn back to support him. They fell into the mud again, and the retreat formation was messed up by the Subduing Tree King alone.

The Fortitude Tree King had no choice. If he did not let these World Tree experts return to support him, the Subduing Tree King would most likely die on the spot.

Black Star had yet to make a move and could launch a sneak attack at any time. He was afraid that the Subduing Tree King would repeat the same mistake and be sealed like the Heart Tree King, causing another Tree King Crown to disappear.

In addition, the Fortitude Tree King did not want the Subduing Tree King to die in battle and enter hibernation. If that happened, wouldn't he have to take charge of the overall situation? He would rather let the other World Tree experts die than to save the Subduing Tree King.

The retreat of the World Tree experts was interrupted, and the Beyond Grade As of both sides fought again.

On the other side, Sun Hunter flew past Dylan and laughed.

"Well done. Your provocation is not bad. You've restrained him!"

"What provocation? I just want to scold him."

Dylan had a look of disdain on his face. He even looked at the Subduing Tree King with anger.

Hearing this, the Beyond Grade As flying around all looked at him with strange gazes.

Scolding the enemy was nothing. If it was a private chat, it would have been fine, but he was scolding them in the public chat. You were attacking the Pugilists, and we all heard it clearly. If you say that it's not a provocation, wouldn't that mean that even our Pugilists were scolded by you?

At this moment, Sierron flew past him with a dissatisfied expression. "Don't bring us Pugilists into the picture when you insult the enemy."

Dylan glanced at him and said matter-of-factly, "You're trash too."

"… Don't stop me. I'm going to kill him now!"

Sierron was furious.

"Business is more important. Ignore him." Sun Hunter quickly grabbed Sierron's finger and dragged him away without much strength.

Dylan had completely adapted to his identity as a Hero Spirit of the Underworld, and he no longer had any scruples when speaking. The Beyond Grade As no longer bothered to lower themselves to his level … After all, what was there to be calculative about with a dead person?

…

On the battlefield, the Subduing Tree King retreated as he fought. His fists and feet were filled with anger, and the power of his attacks increased.

Hila caught up again, and the reddish-black giant's fists struck out rapidly. Its arms were like rubber, constantly pulling back and popping out, and the strength of each strike was constantly increasing.

However, the current Subduing Tree King had no interest in being in a stalemate with her. Every move he made exploded with all his strength, and all of them landed on Hella's body.

After a few rounds, Hella's head was bleeding. She was at a disadvantage and could not retaliate.

Although her form was also good at close combat, there was still a gap between her and the Subduing Tree King who was going all out. After all, the Pugilist class still had some meaning …

Bang!

The fist that was shining with a green cross-shaped light landed deeply on the red-black giant's body, sinking deep into it. The surging Pugilist flames entered the little giant's body.

The next moment, a green light suddenly lit up in the red-black giant's body. In the blink of an eye, it expanded and dyed its entire body a dazzling green. It exploded from the inside out!

Like a balloon exploding, the highly concentrated death energy that formed the transformed body directly exploded, turning into red light fragments that filled the sky. Hella's main body was exposed.

Before Hella could retreat, the Subduing Tree King grabbed her neck and punched Hella's face with his other hand. Blood and broken bones splattered everywhere.

"Strong!"

A golden light flashed, and Hella's heavily injured face instantly recovered. The intense pain did not affect her movements at all. She condensed death energy and was about to exchange injuries for injuries to blast the Subduing Tree King.

However, the Subduing Tree King saw through her plan. He raised his leg and kicked her in the abdomen, interrupting her movements. He kicked her body until it folded and flew backward. Her spine had already been broken by the huge penetrating force.

"Cough, cough, cough …"

Hella spat out a mouthful of blood. She controlled her muscles to correct the position of her spine, reconnecting the broken nerves and blood vessels. She also absorbed a trace of life energy from Aurora's soul connection, allowing her injuries to quickly recover.

The 'Death God Liberation' form had been scattered and was still on cooldown. Although Hella had no intention of admitting defeat, she had no choice but to face the reality that she could not defeat the Subduing Tree King and analyze the current situation.

"Although I can still continue to fight the Subduing Tree King, I can't hold him back. This will let him escape …"

Hella's eyes were still filled with fighting spirit, but she was afraid that she would ruin Han Xiao's goal, so she could only suppress it.

"Did I hurt you?"

Seeing that she did not continue to charge forward, the Subduing Tree King narrowed his eyes and did not chase after her.

Although he had accidentally been left alone and caused a large group of Beyond Grade As of the three Universal Civilizations to surround him, the World Tree experts had returned in time to help and broke through the encirclement that had yet to form, dragging the situation back into a chaotic battle. Therefore, the Subduing Tree King was still in a good situation and was not surrounded.

The Subduing Tree King observed the situation and relaxed a lot. Although Hella was not easy to deal with, she could not stop him at all. With his ability, as long as there were no Beyond Grade As like Black Star to stall him, the chances of him escaping were still very high.

Because of him, the evacuation was interrupted, but he was still safe. The negative consequence was that he had to sacrifice more companions … Although it was a little disadvantageous, as long as he, the Tree King, returned, these losses were still acceptable. After all, his hibernation period was much longer than that of ordinary World Tree experts.

"I didn't expect a simple test to be so dangerous. I can't attack so casually next time."

The Subduing Tree King did not chase after Hella and retreated.

However, at this moment, a strong sense of danger suddenly appeared, as if a large hand had grabbed his heart.

The Subduing Tree King's expression changed slightly, and he looked at the source of the feeling.

A figure appeared out of thin air beside Hila. There was nothing special about his appearance, and he looked very ordinary with a calm expression. However, he was brimming with an unconcealable evil and crazy aura that seemed to seep out from his bones.

EsGod tilted his head and sized up the World Tree Root beside the Subduing Tree King. He revealed a subtle smile and sighed.

"How many years has it been? I've finally seen this thing with my own eyes … Heh, if I hadn't seen it, I might not have been imprisoned for nearly a hundred years."

The Subduing Tree King frowned and felt a strong threat from this stranger.

He had already blocked the mental fluctuations of outsiders and did not know what EsGod was saying. He turned around and ran without hesitation.

This unfamiliar Beyond Grade A who had suddenly appeared was obviously not a simple character. The outcome of the battle would probably not be decided anytime soon. If he was dragged here, it would be dangerous. Therefore, the Subduing Tree King did not want to fight at all.

However, before he could fly far, the smiling EsGod had already teleported in front of him.

The Subduing Tree King's eyes darkened, and a powerful flame condensed in his fist as he punched at EsGod. He planned to use the shockwave to force this guy back.

A green Pugilist light beam shot out, and its power was enough to destroy a planet. However, EsGod only raised his hand casually and activated his Energy Deflection Esper Ability, refracting this beam of light and destroying a large number of starships like a laser beam.

"Esper?"

The Subduing Tree King's eyes flashed, and he did not intend to stop. He quickly closed in and punched out with his fist shining with green light.

Bang!

The fist hit EsGod's chest without any obstruction, but all the power disappeared without a trace.

The Subduing Tree King's expression changed. Just as he was about to retract his fist, EsGod slapped him with his palm. Green light gushed out and reflected the power of the Subduing Tree King's previous attack.

Boom!

A huge shockwave exploded, and the Subduing Tree King was sent flying.

He hurriedly stopped and looked at EsGod in shock. He removed the mental shield and could not help but ask,

He could not help but ask, "What ability is this?"

"Guess."

EsGod smiled.

Even with the enhancement of his Esper Ability, he would still be injured if he took such a blow head-on. In the past, he would have to worry about the burden on his body, so he would not dare to play like this. He rarely fought head-on … But now, his body was only temporary. He did not have to care about the consequences at all.

EsGod had a rare feeling of being free from worries. He hooked his finger at the Subduing Tree King.

"Come, let me see what the Tree King is capable of."

"… Your ability is not bad. You can absorb my strength and reflect it back, but with just these few moves, you don't have the right to show off in front of me."

The Subduing Tree King quickly calmed himself down and looked at EsGod coldly.

In the short exchange, he had already realized how difficult EsGod was to deal with. He thought that EsGod's Esper Ability was to reflect or refract attacks and that EsGod was good at defense.

However, at this moment, EsGod smiled.

"Is that so? What about this?"

Buzz!

The next moment, sixty to seventy doppelgangers suddenly separated from EsGod's main body. Each doppelganger had a different ability, and they all released the aura of a Beyond Grade A, instantly attracting the attention of everyone present. Countless shocked, shocked, and excited gazes!

"This is …"

The Subduing Tree King was alarmed, and his expression changed drastically.

He had originally thought that this unfamiliar expert was only difficult to deal with and would at most stall him. The real danger came from the encirclement of the other Beyond Grade As … However, at this moment, the sense of danger that EsGod gave him was already close to that of Black Star.

"So there's actually such a strong enemy hidden in this civilization …"

The Subduing Tree King's mood was solemn. Facing such an opponent, he did not dare to think about escaping.

The next second, EsGod and all his doppelgangers launched their attacks at the same time. All kinds of Esper Abilities were used, forming a perfect combination. It was as if they were connected to each other, giving off a unique sense of beauty.

In a head-on clash, EsGod might not be the strongest among the Beyond Grade As, but due to the unprecedented diversity of his abilities, he could be considered the peak of the Beyond Grade As!

"Oh no!"

Endless pressure assaulted him, and the Subduing Tree King's eyes widened. He realized that he could not find any flaws, and he could not help but be shocked.

The strength of this strong enemy in front of me is beyond my expectations. He seems to have the strength to kill me alone?
